name: C. Joseph Vijay
portfolio: Public, Home/Police, Municipal Administration and Water Supply, Special Initiatives
prior_experience: First election in 2026; no prior political office; won Perambur and Tiruchirappalli East, kept Perambur
facts: Sworn in as Chief Minister on 10 May with 9 ministers (ThePrint, 10 May 2026)
Won the trust vote 144 to 22 with 5 neutral on 13 May; the DMK's 59 MLAs walked out (ThePrint, 13 May 2026)
Ordered a women's safety force (Singappen, launched 9 June, Rs 354 crore) and an anti-drug task force (order 8 Aug, Rs 264.14 crore) (South First, 17 Aug 2026)

TNM counted four custodial deaths from May to 24 July (one source); in the Thoothukudi case police say the man collapsed, the family alleges assault, and a magisterial inquiry was held (TNM, 24 Jul 2026)
Apologised in the Assembly, 'I am sorry', after Forests Minister R.V. Ranjithkumar named Karunanidhi without an honorific (one source) (The Week, 18 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: both promised forces exist; no police-reform step found (South First, 17 Aug 2026)

name: N. Anand
prior_experience: Puducherry MLA from 2006; no prior ministerial post
facts: Budget of 5 Aug announced Vetri Veedu Thittam: 70,000 pucca houses in year one at Rs 5 lakh each (DT Next, 5 Aug 2026)
Promised 10,000 rural ponds (Rs 650 crore) with no timeline (one source) (DT Next, 20 Aug 2026)
Mettur dam opened on 1 Sept for samba, not the usual 12 June, citing low storage (DT Next, 1 Sep 2026)

Alleged: a 2 July High Court petition by a TVK lawyers' wing functionary alleged payments for government-advocate posts and named Anand; no order or response was reported (one source) (LiveLaw, 2 Jul 2026)
A Rs 16.83 lakh tender with a six-hour window was cancelled on 19 May for 'administrative reasons' after the DMK alleged pre-fixing (The Logical Indian, undated)
Promise v delivery: housing and ponds budgeted; no completion figures found (DT Next, 20 Aug 2026)

name: Aadhav Arjuna
portfolio: Public Works (PWD), Highways, Minor Ports, Sports
prior_experience: Former VCK deputy general secretary and former DMK strategist; founded the consultancy Voice of Commons; joined TVK in January 2025 as poll-management general secretary; no prior elected office
facts: Met Union Minister Nitin Gadkari on 2 June to seek road funds; no commitment reported (one source) (DT Next, 2 Jun 2026)
Unveiled a Rs 947.46 crore NH 75 four-laning project on 31 Aug, awaiting final approval (Deccan Chronicle/PTI, 31 Aug 2026)
Mini-stadium works in 62 constituencies halted for redesign (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 2 Sep 2026)

M.K. Stalin linked an ED case accused to Arjuna's wife's family; Arjuna sent a legal notice on 16 June calling it 'false, malicious', and The Federal reports the ED said the accused is unrelated (The Federal, 16 Jun 2026)
Promise v delivery: projects at approval stage; no completed works reported (Deccan Chronicle/PTI, 31 Aug 2026)

name: Dr K.G. Arunraj
prior_experience: Doctor, then IRS officer 2009-2025; no prior elected office (one source)
facts: Four Kilpauk hospital staff punished on 17 July for charging for free care: suspended per DT Next, dismissed per ThePrint (sources differ) (DT Next, 17 Jul 2026)
Made 115 announcements on 17 Aug, including insurance for about 38 lakh people over 70 and a new Public Health Act (Deccan Chronicle, 18 Aug 2026)
Nine dengue deaths to 18 Sept; daily cases rose from 61 to 283 in two days (one source) (DT Next, 18 Sep 2026)
Health allocation Rs 23,357 crore in the 2026-27 budget (Budget speech, 5 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: Rs 25 lakh health cover not given; wider insurance 'under discussion' on 2 Aug (ThePrint/PTI, 2 Aug 2026)

name: K.A. Sengottaiyan
portfolio: Revenue, Disaster Management, Legislative Assembly; Leader of the House
prior_experience: MLA since 1977; former AIADMK minister (Transport, Agriculture, IT, School Education); joined TVK in 2025
facts: Given Finance on 16 May, moved to Revenue on 21 May; no reason stated (DT Next, 21 May 2026)
Announced tablets for 12,466 village officers (Rs 68 crore) and house pattas for about 20 lakh poor families on 17 Aug (Deccan Chronicle, 17 Aug 2026)
Rs 4 lakh each announced for families of 14 lightning victims on 26 Oct (DT Next/PTI, 26 Oct 2026)
Disputed media reports of 35 rain deaths in a day (sources differ) (ThePrint/PTI, 26 Oct 2026)
Rejected a DMK horse-trading allegation on 5 July: 'There is absolutely no truth or substance' (DT Next, 5 Jul 2026)
Madras High Court rejected an election petition against him on 15 Sept (Bar & Bench, 16 Sep 2026)

name: P. Venkataramanan
portfolio: Food and Civil Supplies, Consumer Protection
prior_experience: TVK treasurer and long-time Vijay aide; no prior elected office (one source)
facts: Said on 25 May that ration tenders 'will not be awarded to any particular individual or select group' (DT Next, 25 May 2026)
73,000 new ration cards launched on 13 July (DT Next, 14 Jul 2026)
Fine rice at Rs 30/kg at about 250 outlets from 16 Oct, against Rs 75-85 in the open market (Deccan Chronicle, 16 Oct 2026)
Opposition said rice rose from Rs 55 to Rs 75/kg after May; the minister blamed global factors (ThePrint/PTI, 28 Aug 2026)
Paddy procurement stood at 3 lakh tonnes against an 8 lakh target by 20 Oct (one source) (DT Next, 20 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: new cards and cheap rice delivered; paddy price below the poll promise (DT Next, 10 Aug 2026)

name: C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar
prior_experience: Former BJP state IT wing head; no prior elected office
facts: Free power raised on 10 May to 200 units per two-month cycle for homes using up to 500 units, a Rs 1,545.14 crore subsidy (DT Next, undated)
Said on 18 June the Parandur airport would not go ahead (TNM, 18 Jun 2026)

Power white paper on 25 June: Rs 2.47 lakh crore debt, 65,921 posts vacant, and about Rs 1,028 crore of alleged irregularities in conductor tenders to be investigated; no cases reported registered by 10 Nov (South First, 25 Jun 2026)
Alleged some June power cuts were sabotage; EPS asked for 'solutions not conspiracy theories'; no FIR found (DT Next, 8 Jun 2026)
Power complaint line got about 30,000 calls a day in late Sept (one source) (DT Next, 23 Sep 2026)
As Law Minister, called the 28 Oct police pick-up of an academic over a fake-account post a mistake that had been put right (ThePrint, 29 Oct 2026)

name: A. Rajmohan
prior_experience: TV anchor and comedian; TVK propaganda secretary; no prior elected office
facts: The DMK's breakfast scheme was renamed after K. Kamaraj (15 July order) and extended to Classes 6-8 from 17 Sept, about 35 lakh pupils (Deccan Chronicle, 23 Jul 2026)
Reported on 30 Aug that 219 of 319 Tamil Nadu residents had been rescued in the Nepal floods (Telangana Today, 30 Aug 2026)
School Education got Rs 4,007 crore less than in the interim budget; the government called it 'a correction rather than a cut' (one source) (South First, 5 Aug 2026)
PMK's Anbumani Ramadoss said headmasters were told to fund breakfast set-up costs; no government reply was reported (Deccan Chronicle, 12 Sep 2026)
Promise v delivery: breakfast extension delivered from 17 Sept, by government figures (Deccan Chronicle, 23 Jul 2026)

name: Dr T.K. Prabhu
prior_experience: Dentist; no prior elected office
facts: Ordered inspection of all quarries on 22 May (ThePrint/PTI, 22 May 2026)
23 Virudhunagar quarries suspended on 26 May after a drone survey (TNM, 27 May 2026)
Announced a state mineral corporation on 28 Aug; setting-up not confirmed (Construction World, 28 Aug 2026)
Department said drone checks found violations in 315 of 1,085 quarries, with Rs 300 crore in penalties (one source; period partly before May) (Deccan Chronicle, 7 Sep 2026)
Promise v delivery: enforcement stepped up by department figures; no convictions found (Deccan Chronicle, 7 Sep 2026)

name: S. Keerthana
prior_experience: Born 1996; former political consultant (I-PAC, Showtime); first-time MLA
facts: L&T MoU for Rs 18,600 crore and about 8,200 jobs signed on 4 June (DT Next, undated)
Conclave MoUs on 13 Aug worth Rs 67,452 crore with 1,06,998 jobs (TNM) or Rs 67,542 crore with 1,21,788 jobs (The Week) (sources differ) (TNM, 14 Aug 2026)
DMK's T.R.B. Rajaa said about 70 of the 97 MoUs were DMK-era leads; Keerthana said they mix new investors and expansions; no MoU list was published (ThePrint, 13 Aug 2026)

Said on 22 June that 25 projects worth Rs 3.3 lakh crore went to other states under the DMK and 'No project has left Tamil Nadu in the last 40 days' (minister's claim, one source) (DT Next, 22 Jun 2026)
Cabinet cleared 8 projects worth Rs 3,767 crore about 29 Oct (one source) (DT Next, 30 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: MoUs are commitments, not investment; no data on money actually invested (TNM, 14 Aug 2026)

name: P. Viswanathan
portfolio: Higher Education, Electronics, Science and Technology
prior_experience: Congress MLA, Melur; prior experience not verified
facts: Budget of 5 Aug provided Rs 2,000 crore for the Vetri Laptop Scheme for college students (Budget speech, 5 Aug 2026)
Vice-chancellor search committees being formed with the Governor, including a UGC nominee (one source) (The Federal, 10 Nov 2026)
His 21 June dance at an anti-drug event on a school campus was criticised; he asked, 'Is there anything wrong in sharing that happiness?' (DT Next, 21 Jun 2026)
A POCSO complaint exists over a video from the event; no FIR was reported; he called it politically motivated (one source) (Careers360, 25 Jun 2026)
Promise v delivery: laptops budgeted; distribution start not verified (Budget speech, 5 Aug 2026)

name: S. Rajesh Kumar
prior_experience: Congress MLA, Killiyoor; prior experience not verified
facts: Said on 14 Aug that Rs 200 crore would make Mahabalipuram a tourism hub with Union help; put river tourism at Rs 60 crore against Rs 53 crore in the budget (sources differ) (DT Next, 14 Aug 2026)
Announced tourist security units in five regions and AI cameras at busy sites on 19 Aug (ThePrint/PTI, 19 Aug 2026)
Opened a state pavilion at a Paris travel fair on 15 Sept (Deccan Chronicle, 16 Sep 2026)
Said on 30 Aug the two Congress ministers would leave the cabinet if TVK did not accept Rahul Gandhi as the 2029 PM candidate; no resignation followed by 10 Nov (TNM, 31 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: announcements only; none verified as implemented (ThePrint/PTI, 19 Aug 2026)

name: A.M. Shahjahan
prior_experience: IUML state secretary; prior experience not verified from a credible outlet
facts: Haj subsidy for first-time pilgrims raised from Rs 25,000 to Rs 35,000 in the 5 Aug budget (Deccan Chronicle, 5 Aug 2026)
Announced on 27 Aug a tuition waiver for Muslim women on government quota (Rs 20 crore) and a Rs 100 crore interest-free loan fund (one source on amounts) (ThePrint/PTI, 27 Aug 2026)
The High Court struck down the 2024 converts' BC quota order on 25 June and the Supreme Court dismissed the state's appeal (South First, 15 Oct 2026)
Said on 18 Oct a review petition or amendment would be weighed 'within a couple of weeks' (DT Next/PTI, 19 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: no report of the tuition waiver or loan fund operating by 10 Nov (ThePrint/PTI, 27 Aug 2026)

name: Vanni Arasu
portfolio: Social Justice (Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare)
prior_experience: VCK deputy general secretary; the state's first Social Justice minister; prior experience not verified from a credible outlet
facts: Department renamed Social Justice about 8 July; he said funds would not be diverted; VCK general secretary D. Ravikumar criticised the renaming (DT Next, 9 Jul 2026)
Hostel food allowance for school students raised from Rs 1,400 to Rs 1,800 a month and 150 new hostels (Rs 160 crore) announced on 28 Aug (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 28 Aug 2026)
Cabinet approved a commission on 29 Oct to frame a 2027 social justice survey (one source) (South First, 29 Oct 2026)
Said on 3 Oct a hostel request for beef 'would be considered'; Puthiya Tamilagam's K. Krishnasamy asked him to withdraw it (DT Next, 3 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: honour-killings law promised 6 July; no bill by 10 Nov (ETV Bharat, 6 Jul 2026)

name: A. Vijay Tamilan Parthiban
prior_experience: Profession and prior posts not found in credible outlets; no prior office found
facts: 300 new buses flagged off on 25 June, Rs 127.21 crore (one source on cost) (DT Next, 25 Jun 2026)
Tracking devices and panic buttons for 13,490 buses, Rs 18 crore, announced on 8 Sept (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 9 Sep 2026)

Free travel for women and transgender persons widened on 2 Oct to 12,695 of 18,413 buses under the renamed Vetri Payanam scheme (DT Next, 2 Oct 2026), at about Rs 6,000 crore a year (South First, 2 Oct 2026)
BJP, Congress and PMK leaders criticised private omni-bus festival fares in Sept; no government reply was reported (ThePrint/PTI, 11 Sep 2026)
Promise v delivery: free-travel expansion delivered; the move to buy only AC electric buses is a direction, with no tender found (DT Next, 17 Jun 2026)

name: B. Rajkumar
prior_experience: Age 46; rose through Vijay's fan organisation; TVK district secretary; no prior office found
facts: Housing board online sales portal for 7,659 units launched 12 Aug; 660 sold by late Aug (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 29 Aug 2026)
Announced on 28 Aug self-certified approval for homes up to 5,000 sq ft and Rs 2,882.62 crore to rebuild 12,648 old flats (ThePrint/PTI, 28 Aug 2026)
His 28 Aug remark that voters ended a '50-year failed legacy' drew DMK and AIADMK objections (one source) (DT Next, 29 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: start of rebuilding not reported by 10 Nov (ThePrint/PTI, 28 Aug 2026)

name: V. Sampath Kumar
portfolio: Backward Classes and Most Backward Classes Welfare
prior_experience: Age 52; ghee trader; 20+ years in Vijay's fan organisation; no prior office found
facts: MBC Welfare Board set up with Rs 3 crore and hostel food allowance raised on 27 Aug (DT Next, 27 Aug 2026)
Assembly unanimously asked the Centre about 8 Sept to list BC and MBC castes in the 2027 Census, after DMK members had been evicted from the House (one source) (DT Next, 9 Sep 2026)

Asked on 6 Nov about alleged irregularities in the school bicycle and book tender, he said a committee would inquire and the state was buying 'at a lower price' (one source) (Devdiscourse/ANI, 6 Nov 2026)
Promise v delivery: the promised caste survey is deferred until after the Union Census (DT Next, 29 Aug 2026)

name: M. Vijay Balaji
prior_experience: Erode shopkeeper; about 25 years in Vijay's fan organisation; age 39 (DT Next) or 37 (South First) (sources differ); no prior office found
facts: 1 July order for the Pongal 2027 free dhoti-saree scheme, Rs 642.88 crore, with Rs 300 crore released (DT Next, 9 Jul 2026)
Announced a 10% rise in basic wages and DA for co-operative handloom weavers on 1 Sept (Deccan Chronicle, 2 Sep 2026)

Virudhunagar weavers protested the new saree design for over three months and looms stood idle for lack of skilled workers; no government reply was reported (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 13 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: pledged on 22 Aug 'there will be no delay'; that is at risk in at least one district (ThePrint/PTI, 22 Aug 2026)

name: K. Vignesh
prior_experience: Age 38; CCTV business; 15+ years in Vijay's fan organisation; no prior office found
facts: 717 liquor outlets near schools, places of worship and bus stands ordered shut on 11 May; he said 436 had closed by 23 May, PMK said about 150 (sources differ) (DT Next, 23 May 2026)
Two pay rises (7 July and 31 Aug) took a TASMAC salesman from Rs 15,530 to Rs 30,284, about 95% (idly's calculation) (DT Next, 31 Aug 2026)
Said on 23 Sept there would be no retail price hike 'in the near future'; from 1 Nov MRP rose Rs 10 a bottle while a separate Rs 10 deposit charge was scrapped (DT Next, 30 Oct 2026)
Government said on 31 Aug Rs 10-a-bottle overcharging had been 'entrenched'; the DMK disputed this and said 603 outlets were closed under its rule (DT Next, 1 Sep 2026)
Digital payment made mandatory above Rs 1,000 from 1 Nov (one source) (Business Today, 27 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: 717 closures done; said on 7 Aug all outlets breaking distance rules 'will be relocated soon' (DT Next, 8 Aug 2026)

name: K. Thennarasu
prior_experience: Age 36; fan-organisation mobiliser; no prior office found
facts: Set up helplines and a Delhi control room during the Nepal floods; put the stranded at 103 on 27 Aug (Deccan Chronicle, 27 Aug 2026)
Met families of 49 missing pilgrims about 14 Sept and said efforts would be 'expedited'; families complained of slow information (one source) (DT Next, 15 Sep 2026)
An investment desk for non-resident Tamils announced in the 5 Aug budget, no amount (one source) (IMPRI, 12 Sep 2026)
Promise v delivery: no policy decisions found beyond the Nepal response; coverage thin (Deccan Chronicle, 27 Aug 2026)

name: J. Mohamed Farvas
prior_experience: Age 31; law graduate per affidavit; no prior office found
facts: After the Tiruvallur ammonia leak he said on 22 June those responsible 'would face legal consequences'; the CM ordered a statewide safety review (DT Next, 22 Jun 2026)
The leak's toll was reported as 5 on 22 June and 11 by about 25 June (sources differ); an official committee found the alarm had failed, and no prosecution was found (Telangana Today, 25 Jun 2026)
Gig workers' accident cover doubled to Rs 10 lakh on 1 Sept (HR Katha, 3 Sep 2026)
Department said Rs 688.09 crore was paid to 6,88,674 welfare-board beneficiaries from 10 May to 30 Sept (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 12 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: unemployment aid of Rs 4,000 for graduates not started (one source) (Hans India/IANS, 28 Sep 2026)

name: V. Gandhiraj
prior_experience: Age 52; civil contractor; former Arakkonam municipal councillor, his only prior elected office found
facts: Co-operative crop loans waived on 16 June up to Rs 75,000 (Rs 35,000 off larger loans) for 14.43 lakh farmers at Rs 5,932.23 crore (South First, 16 Jun 2026)
Recovery from partly waived farmers halted about 21 Sept; Rs 5,267 crore cleared for 13.34 lakh farmers (one source) (Hans India, 22 Sep 2026)
Said on 24 May the DMK-era jewel-loan waiver would go to the CM 'for reconsideration'; no revival found (Devdiscourse/PTI, 25 May 2026)
Thoothukudi farmers said on 6 Sept pledged jewels had not been returned; society secretaries said 'the official order is awaited' (one source) (DT Next, 6 Sep 2026)
Promise v delivery: capped waiver mostly paid; a complete waiver was not done (Hans India/IANS, 28 Sep 2026)

name: K. Jegadeshwari
prior_experience: Age 40; former journalist (one source); no prior office found
facts: Said on 5 July raising the women's monthly aid from Rs 1,000 to Rs 2,500 is 'a matter of time', no date given (DT Next, 5 Jul 2026)

Budget of 5 Aug: Rs 14,414 crore for the existing aid, Rs 812 crore for gold coins and saris for brides, Rs 560 crore for gold rings for newborns; which department runs the gold schemes is not confirmed (PRS, 2026-27 budget analysis)
EPS cited the unmet Rs 2,500 promise on budget day; the government said no welfare scheme was cut (ThePrint/PTI, 5 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: Rs 1,000 continues; Rs 2,500 'under consideration' at 10 Nov (The Federal, 10 Nov 2026)

name: R. Vinoth
prior_experience: Age 32; with Vijay's organisation since 2011; won by 679 votes; no prior office found
facts: Kuruvai paddy package (Rs 134 crore) extended to non-delta farmers on 5 Aug (DT Next, 5 Aug 2026)
Presented the agriculture budget on 6 Aug with five-year missions for soil, pulses, oilseeds, cotton and millets (DT Next, 6 Aug 2026)
Paddy raised to Rs 2,750 a quintal (fine) and Rs 2,600 (common), sugarcane to Rs 4,000 a tonne on 10 Aug (ThePrint/PTI, 10 Aug 2026)
Said on 24 July Karnataka had sent Vijay an invitation on Mekedatu and Tamil Nadu would 'never allow' the project (Telangana Today, 24 Jul 2026)
Promise v delivery: prices raised but below the campaign figures; delta farmers asked for the price promised during the polls (DT Next, 10 Aug 2026)

name: C. Vijayalakshmi
prior_experience: Age 50; first election; beat former AIADMK minister P. Thangamani
facts: Milk procurement price raised from Rs 38 to Rs 41 a litre on 19 Aug, the first change since Nov 2022; a producers' leader said 'We asked for Rs 10. They gave Rs 3' (one source) (The Federal, 19 Aug 2026)
Raised again to Rs 44 a litre, the manifesto figure, on 31 Aug (Rural Voice, 31 Aug 2026)
Ordered 'uninterrupted availability of milk' on 18 Sept after dealers alleged supply cuts (DT Next, 18 Sep 2026)
Aavin raised prices of 63 products from 28 Oct, ghee from Rs 700 to Rs 780 a litre; EPS criticised it and Aavin said over 90% of the extra revenue goes to producers (DT Next, 27 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: Rs 44 a litre delivered in two steps (Rural Voice, 31 Aug 2026)

name: D. Sarathkumar
prior_experience: BBA; first election, won Tambaram by 35,621 votes
facts: Department asked all secretaries on 10 June for details of consultants and re-employed retirees; no decision found (one source) (NewKerala/IANS, Jun 2026)

Alleged: from about 26 June a resurfaced clip was said to show him crushing a white substance; he said it was a prescribed tablet crushed for his young daughter, a treating doctor reportedly confirmed the prescription, and the CM ordered a 'full investigation' whose outcome was not found (The Federal, 30 Jun 2026)

Alleged: an election flying squad official filed a police complaint alleging he gave cash to voters during a by-election campaign; no FIR status or reply was reported (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 29 Jun 2026)
Promise v delivery: no HRM delivery found; coverage thin (NewKerala/IANS, Jun 2026)

name: S. Ramesh
prior_experience: Age 31; engineer; former TVK spokesperson; first election
facts: Withdrew approval on 19 June for 46 DMK-era temple-funded marriage halls and shopping complexes worth Rs 246 crore, none started; DMK called the reviews vendetta (ThePrint, 20 Jun 2026)
Five-year mission to renovate 3,000 temples in the 5 Aug budget (DT Next, 5 Aug 2026)
Agama classification of 34,971 temples published for public objections about 27 Aug (DT Next, 28 Aug 2026)

A Palani temple parking plot valued at Rs 100-120 crore was registered to private parties in July; an FIR was filed and the sub-registrar suspended; Ramesh denied a claim that the buyer was his relative and filed a police complaint over it (DT Next, 15 Jul 2026)
Asked if he got the department for being Brahmin, said 'No posts were given to us based on caste consideration' (PTI via Devdiscourse, 23 May 2026)
Promise v delivery: the department 'revamp' he promised on 7 July was not found announced (DT Next, 8 Jul 2026)

name: P. Mathan Raja
prior_experience: Engineer and businessman; first election; no prior office found (one source)
facts: MSME allocation Rs 2,142 crore in the 5 Aug budget (DT Next, 6 Aug 2026), against Rs 1,943 crore in the DMK's interim budget (TNM, Feb 2026)
A senior official said about 2 Sept the MSME subsidy pool rose from Rs 320 crore to Rs 600 crore (one source) (Deccan Chronicle, 3 Sep 2026)
A Coimbatore startup incubator planned in Sept, cost not stated (Deccan Chronicle, 23 Sep 2026)
Industry bodies said the budget had no new estates and no cut in electricity fixed charges; no government reply was found (KNN India, 6 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: no large dedicated MSME fund found in the budget; coverage thin (DT Next, 6 Aug 2026)

name: N. Marie Wilson
prior_experience: Age 46; PhD in management; first-time MLA; affidavit declares two pending cases, no convictions
facts: Took Finance on 21 May, five days after it was first given to K.A. Sengottaiyan; no official reason reported (DT Next, 21 May 2026)
White paper of 16 June put state debt at about Rs 10 lakh crore, 28.3% of GSDP (The Federal, 16 Jun 2026)

First budget on 5 Aug: spending Rs 4,72,585 crore and a fiscal deficit of 3.00% of GSDP; the white paper's 2025-26 revenue deficit of Rs 78,324 crore differs from Rs 69,219 crore in budget papers (sources differ; different basis) (PRS, 2026-27 budget analysis)
Stalin said the budget lacked 'original thinking' and EPS cited the unmet Rs 2,500 promise; the government said no welfare scheme was cut (ThePrint/PTI, 5 Aug 2026)
A circular to recover 'excess' pension payouts under the DMK's TAPS scheme was withheld about 17 Oct after staff protests (DT Next, 18 Oct 2026)
DA raised from 60% to 63% about 31 Oct (one source) (DT Next, 1 Nov 2026)

name: A. Srinath
prior_experience: Age 52; film actor and director; first election, beat former DMK minister P. Geetha Jeevan
facts: Lean-season aid raised from Rs 6,000 to Rs 7,000 for 1.93 lakh families, Rs 135 crore, in the 5 Aug budget (Budget speech, 5 Aug 2026)
Said on 13 Aug after nine arrests that he would raise them in Delhi; whether the meeting happened was not found (DT Next, 13 Aug 2026)
Daily aid to missing fishers' families raised from Rs 350 to Rs 600 and Rs 1.86 crore for boats seized by Sri Lanka and never recovered, on 2 Sept (DT Next, 2 Sep 2026)
AIADMK's R.B. Udhayakumar said Vijay had promised Rs 20,000 in ban-period aid; no government reply was reported (DT Next, 8 Aug 2026)
Fishermen in Sri Lankan custody fell from 58 on 27 May to 20 on 5 Oct, but arrests continued to 1 Nov (one source) (Telangana Today, 1 Nov 2026)

name: S. Kamali
prior_experience: Age 28; postgraduate and BEd; first election, beat Union Minister of State L. Murugan by 15,373 votes (one source)
facts: Inspected veterinary hospitals in the Nilgiris on 29 May (Nilgiris district release, May 2026)
Rs 57 crore sanctioned about 28 Oct for free milch cows for 10,000 rural women; department not named (Deccan Chronicle/PTI, 28 Oct 2026)
Rs 109.75 crore sanctioned about 31 Oct for five goats or sheep each to 30,000 women (ThePrint/PTI, 31 Oct 2026)
Promise v delivery: no animals reported distributed by 10 Nov; coverage thin (ThePrint/PTI, 31 Oct 2026)

name: R. Kumar
portfolio: Artificial Intelligence, IT and Digital Services
prior_experience: Civil engineer and businessman; first election, beat AIADMK's M.K. Ashok
facts: The AI ministry was created on 21 May; no remit was published (DT Next, 21 May 2026)
Rs 85 crore package announced on 25 Aug: a Rs 50 crore deep-tech fund, Rs 20 crore AI centres, a Rs 10 crore GPU cluster and a Rs 5 crore super app (Angel One, 26 Aug 2026)
State agency ELCOT and IIT Madras's Pravartak signed an MoU on 5 Nov to plan a state AI data centre; no value or site (one source) (Let's Data Science, Nov 2026)
Department budget Rs 398 crore; the only priced new AI item in the budget speech is a Rs 5 crore feasibility study for an AI city (Budget speech, 5 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: the promised ministry exists; no fund, GPU cluster or super app found live by 10 Nov (Angel One, 26 Aug 2026)

name: R.V. Ranjithkumar
prior_experience: Age 50; panchayat union councillor from 2006; earlier in Congress, AIADMK and AMMK; no Assembly or ministerial experience found
facts: Rs 20 crore for human-elephant conflict measures announced on 13 Aug (Deccan Chronicle, 13 Aug 2026)

Promised on 18 Aug Rs 10 lakh to each family of three Tamil men killed by Karnataka forest staff on 15 Aug; payment not confirmed (DT Next, 18 Aug 2026); Karnataka says the men were suspected poachers and a guard fired in self-defence (TNM, 21 Aug 2026)
Rs 100 crore five-year forest scheme, Rs 60 crore fire scheme and training for 1,947 new staff announced on 7 Sept (Deccan Chronicle, 8 Sep 2026)
On 17 Aug he named Karunanidhi without an honorific while alleging past cash-for-votes; after DMK protests the CM apologised in the House (one source) (The Week, 18 Aug 2026)
Promise v delivery: smart fencing and cameras announced on 6 July were not confirmed in place (one source) (DT Next, 6 Jul 2026)

name: D. Logesh Tamilselvan
prior_experience: Age 42; son of former AIADMK Speaker P. Dhanapal; lost the 2024 Lok Sabha poll as AIADMK candidate; won Rasipuram by 679 votes
facts: GST scrutiny notices limited to fraud or major mismatch, with written reasons, from 25 June (one source) (A2Z Taxcorp, 27 Aug 2026)
Online 'no-visit' registration of first property sales began 17 Aug (DT Next, 7 Jul 2026); 2,46,260 documents by 3 Nov (Deccan Chronicle, 5 Nov 2026)
Random GST vehicle checks ended on 14 Oct (one source) (Taxscan, 15 Oct 2026)
On the Palani temple land registration he said the sub-registrar acted on High Court directions, admitted 'a lapse', and said action could reach higher officials (DT Next, 15 Jul 2026)
Promise v delivery: the budget targets 31% growth in stamps and registration; October grew about 8% on Rs 1,950 crore (idly's calculation, one month only) (Deccan Chronicle, 5 Nov 2026)

name: Dr V.K. Rajeev
prior_experience: Age 33; doctor; first election
facts: Said on 18 Aug the state 'will not allow any projects' that harm people, on four proposed offshore wells near Pichavaram; noted earlier wells were approved under the DMK (three) and AIADMK (one); no decision found (Deccan Chronicle/PTI, 18 Aug 2026)
